title: File the annual unclaimed property holder report (Nevada)
description: Businesses holding property that has gone unclaimed — uncashed payroll or vendor checks, customer credits and refunds, unused gift cards, deposits — must report and turn it over to the state each year, after sending the owner a due diligence notice before the deadline. The annual report and payment are due October 31 for general property. A negative report is required even when the business holds nothing. Which state's law applies depends on the owner's last known address, or the business's state of incorporation when there is none, so a business can owe reports to several states.

feeDetail.note: There is no fee to file or register.

penalty.note: Civil penalty of $200 a day up to $5,000, plus 18% annual interest; willful failures carry $1,000 a day up to $25,000 plus 25% of the property's value (NRS 120A).
